title: Sissirat
html:
Sissirat

Sissirat (Algernon) Level 1-20

Sissirat is a Poison Whisker Shaman located off level 7 of Algernon in Sissirat's Lair.

As Poison resistance is essential in this fight, wear the best Poison resistance equipment you can find and preferably use the poison resistance self-buff skill you can buy from the Ranger trainer. Rattle Toe, Poison Broodlings and Whisker Venomspitters will be defending Sissirat, so you will be fighting them all at the same time. Ignore the Poison Broodlings if possible and concentrate on Sissirat to prevent getting mobbed by spawned broodlings.

Skills:

  • Poison Bolt (poison damage)
  • Summon Poison Broodlings
  • Draining Poison (decrease poison resist during 10secs)

Resistances:

  • Good Poison Resist
  • No Fire Resist
  • No Ice Resist
  • Low Shadow Resist
  • No Divine Resist

Sissirat is protected by Rattle Toe, Poison Broodlings and Whisker Venomspitters.

For tips on fighting Sissirat, check out the Sissirat Boss Guide.
